text:
Taylor (People Ops): quick ask 0 want a tiny set of paste-ready goal lines + one evidence cue + one follow-up action managers can use in check-ins. short please.

Iris: format i love: GOAL — metric + deadline
Example: "Shrink deploy rollback rate by 60% by EOY."
Evidence: "rollback incidents down tracked in incident dashboard (Q3 vs Q2)."
Follow-up: "Schedule a 30m postmortem template run with the squad."

Marco: hiring ops example:
Goal: "Reduce interview loop duration to 10 days for backend roles this quarter."
Evidence: "Greenhouse report shows median time."
Follow-up: "Pilot same-day interviewer slots for two weeks."

Sofia: benefits example:
Goal: "Boost voluntary dental enrollment by 25% in next open enrollment."
Evidence: "Sign-up numbers from HRIS."
Follow-up: "Run two brief info sessions and track attendance."

HR Bot: DM snippet to collect a pre-1:1 headline:
`Hey <name> - can you paste a 1-line goal, one sentence of evidence, and one blocker? Example: - Goal: Decrease p95 inference by 20% this quarter. - Evidence: bench + prod metrics. - Blocker: infra time.`

Taylor (People Ops): manager micro-comments (pasteable):
- "Good clear metric; who owns the dependency?"
- "Love the evidence; set a quick milestone for validation."

Iris: anti-pattern to avoid: long task lists or vague verbs ("worked on platform"). keeps reviews unusable.

Taylor (People Ops): great, i'll bundle these into a 1-pager and add to the handbook. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
